narration: A meal on the road can tell you a great deal about a place. Under this thatched roof, people prepare and sell food. Bowls and goods sit close to the customers. In front, a carrier balances a broad tray on her head. Follow the hands that prepare a meal and the body that carries it. A visitor might ask what to order, where to sit, or how food reached the street. The exact dishes are not clear enough to name from this picture alone. Rather than a menu, the scene offers a view of people earning a living. The work is attributed to Uncho. From the TJ Kim Collection, an unfamiliar shop becomes a place of familiar human effort.
